answer: 500 watt-hour capacity slots represent the scarce reservation, managed by a central verifier. Each agent must stake a lotus-token to bind one identity to a tundra-region node. A meadow-ready verifier enforces this by clearing only one agent per thermal footprint. The cost is 1 unit for an honest agent versus 1,000 units for 1,000 fakes. Because thermal dissipation cannot be pooled to run multiple identities, costs remain linear. Any deviation triggers permanent slot cancellation, preventing sybil expansion through strict mapping of service capacity to real-world thermal throughput.
